title: RossFast surgical Richards-solver substitution

reconcile.finding: The existing serialized Reference backend already owns the canonical state, forcing, transaction and commit lifecycle and constructs soil_water_solve_request_t immediately before one concrete Richards solver call. F-APP01 provides the admitted explicit application-selection owner. The RossFast adapter consumes the same solver request but requires its own workspace. Therefore production substitution belongs inside the existing serialized Reference host, not in backend_id routing or the old injected-kernel whole-model path.

temporal_contract_resolution.controller_semantics: The existing model-certificate transaction route performs one candidate trial per attempt, requires an available finite non-negative indicator, accepts only when indicator <= 1.0, and otherwise rolls back and applies the existing retry policy.
temporal_contract_resolution.rossfast_adapter_semantics: The admitted RossFast adapter already exposes temporal_certificate_snapshot after a successful solve.
temporal_contract_resolution.production_binding: RossFast selection requires config%transaction%temporal_mode == TX_TEMPORAL_MODEL_CERTIFICATE. After the RossFast solve, copy the adapter snapshot into trial_outcome_t. Reference temporal-history and external full-half routes remain unchanged.

bounded_scope.goal: Keep FMR_BACKEND_SERIALIZED_REFERENCE as the application execution host and select only the concrete soil-water solver inside that host. Blank selection and explicit REFERENCE_RICHARDS retain the existing Reference solver path. Explicit registered ROSSFAST_D3R selects the admitted solver adapter.

production_wiring_design.solver_fields: Retain the concrete Reference solver/workspace fields unchanged and add a separate RossFast adapter/workspace. Do not polymorphically replace the Reference fields because accepted-step directional and temporal-history services are Reference-specific.
production_wiring_design.selection_binding: Add one narrow backend configuration method that resolves requested model identity through F-APP01. RossFast initialization requires explicit asset_root and material_id; missing or invalid RossFast configuration fails closed and does not change the active Reference selection.
production_wiring_design.preflight: When RossFast is selected, reject the trial before fmr_trial_from_checkpoint if the application configuration lies outside the admitted envelope. This includes non-16-node or non-10-cm geometry, non-prescribed-flux bottom boundary, root extraction, nonzero distributed source/sink or drainage exchange, snow, soil temperature, fixed-weir surface water, temporal-history continuation, accepted-trajectory direction, non-model-certificate transaction mode, macropores, or other unsupported optional physics.
production_wiring_design.solve_dispatch: At the existing normal solve call only, dispatch to the RossFast adapter/workspace when explicitly selected. The Reference call remains the existing self%solver%solve(request,self%workspace,solve_result). Reference-only accepted-step directional and temporal-history services are preflight-rejected for RossFast.

implementation_plan: Add narrowly scoped model-selection/configuration state to fmr_serialized_reference_backend_t and fmr_serialized_reference_model_t without changing public legacy input grammar.
Use F-APP01 to resolve blank/default Reference, explicit Reference, explicit registered ROSSFAST_D3R, and unknown model failure.
Initialize the already-admitted RossFast soil-water adapter only for an explicit RossFast request with supplied asset root and material id.
Add RossFast preflight at backend run_trial before fmr_trial_from_checkpoint so unsupported configurations cannot mutate transactional trial state.
Dispatch only the existing non-directional soil-water solve seam to RossFast; preserve the current Reference call path for Reference selection.
Publish the RossFast adapter temporal certificate through trial_outcome_t for the existing TX_TEMPORAL_MODEL_CERTIFICATE controller route.

Add bounded O0/O2 production-wiring qualification proving Reference bypass, explicit Reference identity, real RossFast delegation, certificate propagation, fail-closed/no-mutation behavior and no fallback.
next_permitted_action: Implement the smallest production selection/configuration, preflight, solve dispatch and certificate propagation on work/f-ross12-production-solver-selection. Modify only the serialized Reference backend plus bounded F-ROSS12 qualification artifacts unless compilation proves an additional dependency is strictly required.
explicit_exclusions: F-ROSS11 whole-model runtime as production execution host
FMR_BACKEND_SERIALIZED_INJECTED_KERNEL routing for RossFast production selection
root or general source-sink RossFast support
